column1: # The third-party colour scheme files the accent run measures (tools/kde-host/accent-pairs.tsv),
# each pinned in docs/facts/sources.toml by commit. os-probe.yml's kde-accent job fetches each
# repository at its commit (git fetch --depth 1 by SHA) into kde-accent-schemes/<id>/ and fails
# unless the checkout's HEAD is the commit and the file's SHA-256 is the one below. The files are
# fetched, never committed (their licences are their projects').
